blocks.text: Managing your logistics coordinator tasks on Mac

Logistics coordinators face a high volume of time-sensitive digital tasks. You are the bridge between shippers, carriers, and warehouse teams. Your computer is your primary office. You spend hours reading emails, updating shipment statuses, and answering ETA requests. You also handle invoice discrepancies and dock-door scheduling. These tasks require constant attention to detail in your TMS or ERP system.

Many coordinators use web-based tools on macOS. You might use MercuryGate or McLeod for your TMS needs. You likely use Gmail or Outlook for communication. You probably use Excel or Google Sheets for reporting. These platforms are powerful but often feel fragmented. You switch between tabs constantly. This context switching slows you down.
Logistics tracking software help when you need it

When you need logistics tracking software help, you often search through documentation or menus. Lazur changes this by acting as a voice assistant. You hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask a question about your screen. Lazur looks at your interface and answers out loud. If you are stuck in a complex TMS menu, ask Lazur to guide you. It circles the button you need to click next.

Email is a major part of your day. You spend a large portion of your week drafting responses to carriers and clients. You can use the fn key to dictate clean text directly into your email client. This is faster than typing every update about a delayed shipment. It helps you keep your inbox under control without losing focus.

blocks.text: Data entry and reporting in Excel

Reporting on inventory accuracy and vendor performance takes time. You often compile data from multiple spreadsheets. If you forget a formula or a menu path in Excel, do not waste time searching. Hold the shortcut and ask how to perform the action. Lazur explains the steps clearly. It lets you stay in the flow of your analysis.
If you handle sensitive client or carrier data, follow your company's security policies. Lazur does not store your content or use it to train AI models.
blocks.title: Data Privacy

blocks.text: Exception management is reactive work. You investigate delays and missing BOLs. You need to find information quickly. Use Lazur to search your browser tabs. Ask it to summarize a report or find a specific status update. This saves you from scrolling through long documents.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in my TMS?
faq.answer: No. Lazur guides you by pointing at buttons and explaining how to proceed. It does not operate your software for you.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with my specific logistics software?
faq.answer: Lazur works on your Mac screen. It can assist with any web-based or desktop application that you view on your monitor.

faq.question: Is my shipment data private?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur does not store your data. It only processes what you show it while you hold the shortcut key.
